reviewer_requirement: At least one external non-author domain reviewer; coauthor review separately labelled, not independent external validation. No reviewer secured or assessment completed by preparing this package.
target: Every material numeric commitment in the complete displayed candidate under its stated conditions, not just one matched value. Independent full-document verification for both arms; no retrospective favorable conditions.
reference_limit: No complete neutral engineering ground truth has been assembled; reviewers may independently consult full sources equally and record unknown. Practice judgments explicitly distinguished from document-grounded judgments.
primary: source-equal mean of [rag(correct AND applicable)/n_rag - norag(correct AND applicable)/n_norag]; 20 source clusters
secondary: same with (correct OR acceptable) AND applicable; item fractions secondary only
unknown: correctness=无法判断 OR applicability=工况不明; preserve independently. If explicit wrong or not applicable, failure is established even when other axis unknown. Remaining unresolved cases create lower/upper bounds; confirmed-success rate uses all sampled rows, not deletion or imputed factual error.
bounds: RAG-unfavorable: unresolved RAG=0,noRAG=1; favorable reverse. Report both endpoints; not confidence intervals.
ci: source-cluster percentile bootstrap of paired confirmed-success differences, 10000 resamples with seed 202610191556, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; exploratory conditional stability interval, not population coverage guarantee; only 20 source clusters and all eligible common sources included
test: only two-sided exact source-level sign test on nonzero primary confirmed-success differences; ties excluded from binomial count but reported; descriptive symmetry/independence assumptions; no outcome-driven test choice; not power or equivalence evidence
agreement: only two complete first-pass independently filled valid workbooks with distinct identities and declarations: exact agreement and unweighted Cohen kappa for each nominal axis including unknown; external/coauthor identities retained; no consensus ratings. Independence is declared, not externally verified.
acceptance_rules: Correct/acceptable need a concrete source locator/version or explicit practice-judgment basis; no uniform +/-20%; one key error prevents whole-row correct
blinding: Only nontechnical metadata omitted; original numeric/unit/operator/qualifier/model/condition preserved exactly. Optional source guessing separate file released only after first-pass submission.
no_outcome: No real scores exist. Empty/incomplete forms must block all outcome statistics.
